versos.grego: Καὶ ἤρξατο αὐτοῖς ἐν παραβολαῖς λαλεῖν. ἀμπελῶνα ἄνθρωπος ἐφύτευσεν, καὶ περιέθηκεν φραγμὸν καὶ ὤρυξεν ὑπολήνιον καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν πύργον, καὶ ἐξέδετο αὐτὸν γεωργοῖς, καὶ ἀπεδήμησεν.

controles.web: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
controles.kjv: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
controles.livre: Então Jesus começou a lhes dizer por parábolas: Um homem plantou uma vinha, cercou-a, fundou nela um esmagador de uvas, edificou uma torre, e a arrendou a uns lavradores; e partiu-se daquela terra.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τοὺς γεωργοὺς τῷ καιρῷ δοῦλον, ἵνα παρὰ τῶν γεωργῶν λάβῃ ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος·

controles.web: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
controles.kjv: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
controles.livre: E, quando chegou o tempo, mandou um servo aos lavradores, para que recebesse dos lavradores do fruto da vinha.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἔδειραν καὶ ἀπέστειλαν κενόν.

controles.web: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
controles.kjv: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
controles.livre: Mas eles, tomando-o à força, feriram-no, e mandaram-no vazio.

versos.grego: καὶ πάλιν ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἄλλον δοῦλον· κἀκεῖνον ἐκεφαλίωσαν καὶ ἠτίμασαν.

controles.web: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
controles.kjv: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
controles.livre: E voltou a lhes mandar outro servo; e eles feriram-no na cabeça e maltrataram-no.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄλλον ἀπέστειλεν· κἀκεῖνον ἀπέκτειναν, καὶ πολλοὺς ἄλλους, οὓς μὲν δέροντες, οὓς δὲ ἀποκτέννοντες.

controles.web: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.
controles.kjv: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
controles.livre: E voltou a mandar outro, ao qual mataram, e mandou muitos outros, e a uns feriram, e a outros mataram.

versos.grego: ἔτι ἕνα εἶχεν, υἱὸν ἀγαπητόν· ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν ἔσχατον πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων ὅτι Ἐντραπήσονται τὸν υἱόν μου.

controles.web: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
controles.kjv: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
controles.livre: Tendo ele, pois, ainda um, o seu filho amado, mandou-lhes também por último a este, dizendo: Pelo menos respeitarão o meu filho.

versos.grego: ἐκεῖνοι δὲ οἱ γεωργοὶ πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς εἶπαν ὅτι Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κληρονόμος· δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτόν, καὶ ἡμῶν ἔσται ἡ κληρονομία.

controles.web: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
controles.kjv: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
controles.livre: Mas aqueles lavradores disseram entre si: Este é o herdeiro; vinde, e o matemos; então a herança será nossa.

versos.grego: καὶ λαβόντες ἀπέκτειναν αὐτόν, καὶ ἐξέβαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος.

controles.web: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
controles.kjv: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
controles.livre: E pegando dele, mataram-no , e lançaram-no fora da vinha.

versos.grego: τί ποιήσει ὁ κύριος τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος; ἐλεύσεται καὶ ἀπολέσει τοὺς γεωργούς, καὶ δώσει τὸν ἀμπελῶνα ἄλλοις.

controles.web: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
controles.kjv: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
controles.livre: Que, pois, o senhor da vinha fará? Ele virá, destruirá aos lavradores, e dará a vinha a outros.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ τὴν γραφὴν ταύτην ἀνέγνωτε Λίθον ὃν ἀπεδοκίμασαν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, οὗτος ἐγενήθη εἰς κεφαλὴν γωνίας·

controles.web: Haven’t you even read this Scripture:  ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.
controles.kjv: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
controles.livre: Acaso ainda não lestes esta escritura: “A pedra que os edificadores rejeitaram, esta foi feita por cabeça de esquina.

versos.grego: παρὰ Κυρίου ἐγένετο αὕτη, καὶ ἔστιν θαυμαστὴ ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς ἡμῶν;

controles.web: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes’?”
controles.kjv: This was the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
controles.livre: Pelo Senhor foi feito isto, e é maravilhoso em nossos olhos”?

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐζήτουν αὐτὸν κρατῆσαι, καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸν ὄχλον· ἔγνωσαν γὰρ ὅτι πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὴν παραβολὴν εἶπεν. καὶ ἀφέντες αὐτὸν ἀπῆλθον.

controles.web: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.
controles.kjv: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
controles.livre: E buscavam prendê-lo, mas temiam a multidão; porque entendiam que era contra eles que dizia aquela parábola; então o deixaram e se retiraram.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀποστέλλουσιν πρὸς αὐτόν τινας τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ τῶν Ἡρῳδιανῶν ἵνα αὐτὸν ἀγρεύσωσιν λόγῳ.

controles.web: They sent some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
controles.kjv: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
controles.livre: E mandaram-lhe alguns dos fariseus e dos herodianos, para que o apanhassem em alguma palavra.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθόντες λέγουσιν αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε, οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀληθὴς εἶ καὶ οὐ μέλει σοι περὶ οὐδενός· οὐ γὰρ βλέπεις εἰς πρόσωπον ἀνθρώπων, ἀλλ’ ἐπ’ ἀληθείας τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ διδάσκεις· ἔξεστιν δοῦναι κῆνσον Καίσαρι ἢ οὔ; δῶμεν ἢ μὴ δῶμεν;

controles.web: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?
controles.kjv: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Cesar, or not?
controles.livre: Eles se aproximaram e lhe disseram: Mestre, sabemos que és homem de verdade, e não te interessa agradar a ninguém, porque não te importas com a aparência humana, mas com verdade ensinas o caminho de Deus. É lícito pagar tributo a César, ou não? Devemos pagar, ou não devemos?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἰδὼς αὐτῶν τὴν ὑπόκρισιν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί με πειράζετε; φέρετέ μοι δηνάριον ἵνα ἴδω.

controles.web: Shall we give, or shall we not give?”   But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”
controles.kjv: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
controles.livre: E ele, entendendo a hipocrisia deles, disse-lhes: Por que estais me tentando? Trazei-me uma moeda,  para que eu a veja.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν. καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Τίνος ἡ εἰκὼν αὕτη καὶ ἡ ἐπιγραφή; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Καίσαρος.

controles.web: They brought it.   He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”   They said to him, “Caesar’s.”
controles.kjv: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Cesar’s.
controles.livre: E trouxeram. E perguntou-lhes: De quem é esta imagem, e a inscrição? E eles lhe disseram: De César.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τὰ Καίσαρος ἀπόδοτε Καίσαρι καὶ τὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ τῷ Θεῷ. καὶ ἐξεθαύμαζον ἐπ’ αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”   They marveled greatly at him.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Cesar the things that are Cesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s. And they marvelled at him.
controles.livre: Então Jesus, lhes respondeu: Dai, pois, a César o que é de César, e a Deus o que é de Deus. E admiram-se dele.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔρχονται Σαδδουκαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν, οἵτινες λέγουσιν ἀνάστασιν μὴ εἶναι, καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες

controles.web: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,
controles.kjv: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
controles.livre: E vieram a ele os saduceus, que dizem não haver ressurreição, e perguntaram-lhe:

versos.grego: Διδάσκαλε, Μωϋσῆς ἔγραψεν ἡμῖν ὅτι ἐάν τινος ἀδελφὸς ἀποθάνῃ καὶ καταλίπῃ γυναῖκα καὶ μὴ ἀφῇ τέκνον, ἵνα λάβῃ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ ἐξαναστήσῃ σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.’
controles.kjv: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man’s brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
controles.livre: Mestre, Moisés nos escreveu que, se o irmão de alguém morresse, e deixasse mulher, mas não filho, que seu irmão se casasse com a viúva  , e gerasse descendência  ao seu irmão.

versos.grego: ἑπτὰ ἀδελφοὶ ἦσαν· καὶ ὁ πρῶτος ἔλαβεν γυναῖκα, καὶ ἀποθνῄσκων οὐκ ἀφῆκεν σπέρμα·

controles.web: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
controles.kjv: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
controles.livre: Houve, pois, sete irmãos, e o primeiro casou-se com a mulher, e morrendo, não deixou descendente.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ δεύτερος ἔλαβεν αὐτήν, καὶ ἀπέθανεν μὴ καταλιπὼν σπέρμα· καὶ ὁ τρίτος ὡσαύτως·

controles.web: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
controles.kjv: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
controles.livre: Casou-se com ela também o segundo, e morreu; e nem este deixou descendente; e o terceiro da mesma maneira.

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ οὐκ ἀφῆκαν σπέρμα. ἔσχατον πάντων καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἀπέθανεν.

controles.web: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
controles.kjv: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
controles.livre: Os sete não deixaram descendente. Finalmente, depois de todos, morreu também a mulher.

versos.grego: ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει, ὅταν ἀναστῶσιν, τίνος αὐτῶν ἔσται γυνή; οἱ γὰρ ἑπτὰ ἔσχον αὐτὴν γυναῖκα.

controles.web: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
controles.kjv: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
controles.livre: Na ressurreição, pois, quando ressuscitarem, ela será a mulher de qual deles? Porque os sete a tiveram por mulher.

versos.grego: ἔφη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐ διὰ τοῦτο πλανᾶσθε μὴ εἰδότες τὰς γραφὰς μηδὲ τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ Θεοῦ;

controles.web: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
controles.livre: E Jesus lhes respondeu: Acaso não é por isso que errais, por não conhecerdes as Escrituras, nem o poder de Deus?

versos.grego: ὅταν γὰρ ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀναστῶσιν, οὔτε γαμοῦσιν οὔτε γαμίζονται, ἀλλ’ εἰσὶν ὡς ἄγγελοι ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
controles.kjv: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
controles.livre: Pois, quando ressuscitarem dos mortos, nem se casarão, nem se darão em casamento; mas serão como os anjos que estão nos céus.

versos.grego: περὶ δὲ τῶν νεκρῶν ὅτι ἐγείρονται, οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ἐν τῇ βίβλῳ Μωϋσέως ἐπὶ τοῦ Βάτου πῶς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Θεὸς λέγων Ἐγὼ ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Θεὸς Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Θεὸς Ἰακώβ;

controles.web: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven’t you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ?
controles.kjv: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
controles.livre: E quanto aos mortos que ressuscitarão, não lestes no livro de Moisés, como Deus lhe falou com a sarça, dizendo: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque, e o Deus de Jacó?

versos.grego: οὐκ ἔστιν Θεὸς νεκρῶν ἀλλὰ ζώντων. πολὺ πλανᾶσθε.

controles.web: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”
controles.kjv: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
controles.livre: Deus não é Deus de mortos, mas de vivos. Portanto errais muito.

versos.grego: Καὶ προσελθὼν εἷς τῶν γραμματέων, ἀκούσας αὐτῶν συνζητούντων, εἰδὼς ὅτι καλῶς ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς, ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτόν Ποία ἐστὶν ἐντολὴ πρώτη πάντων;

controles.web: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”
controles.kjv: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
controles.livre: Então aproximou-se dele um dos escribas, que os havia ouvido discutir. Como ele sabia que Jesus havia lhes respondido bem, perguntou-lhe: Qual é o primeiro mandamento de todos?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι Πρώτη ἐστίν Ἄκουε, Ἰσραήλ, Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν Κύριος εἷς ἐστιν,

controles.web: Jesus answered, “The greatest is, ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
controles.livre: E Jesus respondeu: O primeiro é: “Ouve Israel, o Senhor nosso Deus é o único Senhor;

versos.grego: καὶ ἀγαπήσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς διανοίας σου καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ἰσχύος σου.

controles.web: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.’This is the first commandment.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
controles.livre: amarás, pois, ao Senhor teu Deus com todo o teu coração, com toda a tua alma, com todo o teu entendimento, e com todas as tuas forças.”

versos.grego: δευτέρα αὕτη Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν. μείζων τούτων ἄλλη ἐντολὴ οὐκ ἔστιν.

controles.web: The second is like this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’There is no other commandment greater than these.”
controles.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
controles.livre: E o segundo é: “Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo”.  Não há outro mandamento maior que estes.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ γραμματεύς Καλῶς, Διδάσκαλε, ἐπ’ ἀληθείας εἶπες ὅτι εἷς ἐστιν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλος πλὴν αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,
controles.kjv: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
controles.livre: E o escriba lhe disse: Muito bem, Mestre, com verdade disseste que ele é um só, e não há outro além dele.

versos.grego: καὶ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν αὐτὸν ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς συνέσεως καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ἰσχύος, καὶ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν τὸν πλησίον ὡς ἑαυτὸν περισσότερόν ἐστιν πάντων τῶν ὁλοκαυτωμάτων καὶ θυσιῶν.

controles.web: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
controles.kjv: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
controles.livre: E que amá-lo com todo o coração, com todo o entendimento, e com todas as forças; e amar ao próximo como a si mesmo, é mais que todas as ofertas de queima e sacrifícios.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ὅτι νουνεχῶς ἀπεκρίθη, εἶπεν αὐτῷ Οὐ μακρὰν εἶ ἀπὸ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ. καὶ οὐδεὶς οὐκέτι ἐτόλμα αὐτὸν ἐπερωτῆσαι.

controles.web: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the Kingdom of God.”   No one dared ask him any question after that.
controles.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
controles.livre: Jesus viu que ele havia respondido sabiamente, e disse-lhe: Não estás longe do Reino de Deus. E ninguém mais ousou lhe perguntar.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔλεγεν διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ Πῶς λέγουσιν οἱ γραμματεῖς ὅτι ὁ Χριστὸς υἱὸς Δαυείδ ἐστιν;

controles.web: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
controles.livre: E Jesus respondia e dizia, enquanto ensinava no templo: Como os escribas dizem que o Cristo é filho de Davi?

versos.grego: αὐτὸς Δαυεὶδ εἶπεν ἐν τῷ Πνεύματι τῷ Ἁγίῳ Εἶπεν Κύριος τῷ Κυρίῳ μου Κάθου ἐκ δεξιῶν μου ἕως ἂν θῶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν σου.

controles.web: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit,  ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’
controles.kjv: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
controles.livre: O mesmo Davi disse pelo Espírito Santo: Disse o Senhor ao meu Senhor, senta-te à minha direita, até que eu ponha os teus inimigos debaixo dos teus pés.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς Δαυεὶδ λέγει αὐτὸν Κύριον, καὶ πόθεν αὐτοῦ ἐστιν υἱός; Καὶ ὁ πολὺς ὄχλος ἤκουεν αὐτοῦ ἡδέως.

controles.web: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?”    The common people heard him gladly.
controles.kjv: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
controles.livre: Ora, se o próprio Davi o chama de Senhor, como, pois, é so eu filho?E a grande multidão o ouvia de boa vontade.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ ἔλεγεν Βλέπετε ἀπὸ τῶν γραμματέων τῶν θελόντων ἐν στολαῖς περιπατεῖν καὶ ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς

controles.web: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
controles.kjv: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
controles.livre: E dizia em seu ensino: Cuidado com os escribas, que gostam de andar com roupas compridas, das saudações nas praças,

versos.grego: καὶ πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ πρωτοκλισίας ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις·

controles.web: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:
controles.kjv: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
controles.livre: das primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas, e dos primeiros assentos nas ceias.

versos.grego: οἱ κατεσθίοντες τὰς οἰκίας τῶν χηρῶν καὶ προφάσει μακρὰ προσευχόμενοι, οὗτοι λήμψονται περισσότερον κρίμα.

controles.web: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
controles.kjv: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
controles.livre: que devoram as casas das viúvas, com pretexto de longas orações. Esses receberão mais grave condenação.

versos.grego: Καὶ καθίσας κατέναντι τοῦ γαζοφυλακίου ἐθεώρει πῶς ὁ ὄχλος βάλλει χαλκὸν εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον· καὶ πολλοὶ πλούσιοι ἔβαλλον πολλά·

controles.web: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.
controles.kjv: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
controles.livre: Quando Jesus estava sentado de frente à arca do tesouro, observava como a multidão lançava dinheiro na arca do tesouro; e muitos ricos lançavam muito.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθοῦσα μία χήρα πτωχὴ ἔβαλεν λεπτὰ δύο, ὅ ἐστιν κοδράντης.

controles.web: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
controles.kjv: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
controles.livre: E uma pobre viúva veio, e lançou duas pequenas moedas, de pouco valor.

versos.grego: καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν τῶν βαλλόντων εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον·

controles.web: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
controles.kjv: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
controles.livre: Então Jesus chamou a si os seus discípulos, e disse-lhes: Em verdade vos digo que esta pobre viúva lançou mais que todos os que lançaram na arca do tesouro;

versos.grego: πάντες γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον, αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τῆς ὑστερήσεως αὐτῆς πάντα ὅσα εἶχεν ἔβαλεν, ὅλον τὸν βίον αὐτῆς.

controles.web: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
controles.kjv: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
controles.livre: Porque todos lançaram daquilo que lhes sobra; mas esta, da sua pobreza lançou tudo o que tinha, todo o seu sustento.
